name: ckb-rwa-asset-adapter
description: Reference demo: RWA asset issuance, mocked KYC attestation, and fixed-term lending on CKB testnet.

scripts.test:asset: npm run build:asset && cargo test -p asset-tests
scripts.test:lending: npm run build:lending && cargo test -p lending-tests
scripts.test: npm run test:asset && npm run test:kyc-attestation && npm run test:lending
scripts.build:asset: RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=-a" cargo +1.89.0 build -p rwa-asset-type --release --target riscv64imac-unknown-none-elf
scripts.build:lending: RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=-a" cargo +1.89.0 build -p lending-type --release --target riscv64imac-unknown-none-elf
scripts.build:contracts: npm run build:asset && npm run build:lending
